continuity: Team Leader Choi worked for Ares Guild for roughly three or four years, was immediately transferred overseas by Lee Jungryong so he could not enter headquarters, and resigned the previous year.
Lee Jungryong has known Team Leader Choi since childhood; Choi called him Grandpa when he was young.
Kim Hwajong met Lee Jungryong eighteen years earlier and saved his life during the collapse of Mapo Bridge; Kim deeply regrets having saved him and openly hates him.
Soyeong, Team Leader Choi's mother, died long ago and was the daughter of Cheon Taemin.
Team Leader Choi is Cheon Taemin's maternal grandson.
Cheon Taemin is described as humanity's great hero, the world's greatest Hunter, the Ares Guild Master, and the Slayer who killed the Demon King.
Lee Jungryong's hospital visit was not an apology. He used it to demonstrate his power, brought compensation money and lilies, and demanded that the captives be handed over after negotiations.
Go Jun attacked Taekyung in the hospital room and was defeated; Lee Jungryong's previously controlled composure visibly broke afterward.
Lee Jungryong believes Taekyung learned his martial arts from an older brother, but the identity of that person and the connection to Lee remain unresolved.
plot: Lee Jungryong visits Im Kkeokjeong's hospital room and reveals a long, tense history with Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim. Choi once worked under Ares Guild and was sent overseas by Lee, while Kim saved Lee's life at the collapse of Mapo Bridge eighteen years earlier and now openly despises him. Go Jun attacks Taekyung after he insults Lee, but Taekyung defeats him with ease. Lee then recognizes that Taekyung learned significant martial arts and asks about the older brother who taught him. His questions about Soyeong, Choi's deceased mother, provoke Choi and Kim before Lee leaves, demanding that the captives be handed over after negotiations. Choi reveals that Soyeong was Cheon Taemin's daughter, making him Cheon Taemin's maternal grandson; Taekyung realizes that Cheon Taemin is the Ares Guild Master, the world's greatest Hunter, and the Slayer who killed the Demon King.
translation_decisions: Render 소영 as Soyeong and 천태민 as Cheon Taemin.
Render 슬레이어 as Slayer and 마왕 as Demon King.
Render 도련님 as Young Master, 선배 and 선배님 as Senior, and 형님 in Lee Jungryong's question as older brother.
Retain Team Leader Seok for 석 팀장 and Go Jun for 석고준, without treating them as separate identities.

active_continuity: Taekyung believes Ares Guild used mental magic to manipulate witnesses' memories and knows Ares personnel searched his phone and cloud storage.
Im Kkeokjeong regained consciousness after three days, had both arms reattached, and must avoid strenuous activity for at least two weeks; his return as a Hunter remains uncertain.
Butler Kim and Team Leader Choi funded and arranged Im Kkeokjeong's treatment, and Choi accepts responsibility for the Guild's failure to prevent the attack.
Taekyung defeated the immediate attackers and forced Lee Jungryong to withdraw with Park Jihoon, while sustaining a slight Internal Injury.
Taekyung secured revenge and tacit promises of apology and compensation for Im Kkeokjeong, creating an opportunity for the Peace Guild to grow.
Team Leader Choi intends to make the Peace Guild the world's greatest Guild and accepts responsibility for its actions.
Lee Jungryong is calculating, ruthless, and willing to erase witnesses; his apparent concern for Park Jihoon was an act.
Go Jun, also known as Team Leader Seok, is Lee Jungryong's prized Disciple and right-hand man, personally selected and trained by Lee.
Lee Jungryong ordered Go Jun to monitor Taekyung and intervene if Taekyung became a problem; Go Jun has now attacked Taekyung and been defeated.
Park Jihoon's eventual survival and recovery after Lee ordered him treated only minimally remain unknown.
Team Leader Choi has known Lee Jungryong since childhood, worked for Ares Guild for roughly three or four years, was transferred overseas by Lee, and later resigned.
Kim Hwajong saved Lee Jungryong's life during the collapse of Mapo Bridge eighteen years earlier and now deeply regrets doing so.
Soyeong, Team Leader Choi's deceased mother, was Cheon Taemin's daughter; Choi is Cheon Taemin's maternal grandson.
Cheon Taemin is the Ares Guild Master, humanity's great hero, the world's greatest Hunter, and the Slayer who killed the Demon King.
Lee Jungryong visited the hospital to assert his power rather than apologize, brought lilies and compensation money, and demanded the captives after negotiations.
Lee Jungryong recognizes that Taekyung learned martial arts from an unidentified older brother or teacher, but the person's identity and connection to Lee remain unresolved.
open_questions: Who is the older brother Lee Jungryong believes taught Taekyung martial arts?
What was the exact relationship between Lee Jungryong and Soyeong, and what does his question about her having another man mean?
What is the full relationship between Lee Jungryong and Cheon Taemin's family?
What will happen to Park Jihoon after Lee ordered him treated only minimally and abandoned?
How will Park Tae Seop respond to Lee Jungryong's renewed threat and his own long-standing criminal obligation?
What happened to Team 11 after contact was lost?
What exact wrongdoing did Jung Hyunwoo uncover before Park Jihoon killed him?
Who authorized the Black Hunters to target the Peace Guild's D-rank Hunter?
